description: On desktop, the app's own page may call the agent host through the agent_host_* commands: the shell starts the host for the profile and makes each call, so the launch token stays in the shell (crates/agent-host). The page names a route of the host's table, never a URL, and saves the sandbox choice only by naming a backend (agent_host_sandbox_choice_save), never a file. agent_host_paperclip_restore asks the shell, once a workspace opens, to hand the Paperclip keys it keeps back to the host itself; the page only names the workspace, and the shell decides what goes back and never answers a key (HAL-20278). agent_host_paperclip_key_kept answers only whether the shell keeps a key for a connection the workspace's connection file names, as yes or no, never the key, so a sign-in doesn't write over it (HAL-20265). engine_ready tells the shell the page's engine is ready, which starts the host, and start_status answers how far Studio's start has got, as fixed values only (HAL-13408). It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no agent host.
